Schnittstelle Assoc<K,V>

Typparameter:
K - the key type of the associative array
V - the value type of the associative array
public interface Assoc<K,V>

Interface for a generic associative array (key–value mapping).

Implementations should define their mutability and ordering semantics (e.g., insertion order, sorted order) in their respective documentation. Unless stated otherwise, keys and values are expected to be non-null.

  • Methodendetails

    • put

      @NonNull Assoc<K,V> put(@NonNull K key, @NonNull V value)

      Inserts (or replaces) a key–value pair into this associative array.

      Implementations should document whether an existing entry with the same key is replaced and whether the returned instance is the same object (mutable) or a new instance (immutable).

      Parameter:
      key - the key to insert; must not be null
      value - the value to insert; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      this associative array after inserting the key–value pair (for fluent usage)
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • contains

      boolean contains(@NonNull K key)

      Checks whether this associative array contains the given key.

      Parameter:
      key - the key to check; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      true if this associative array contains the key; false otherwise
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • get

      @NonNull Value<V> get(@NonNull K key) throws NoSuchElementException

      Looks up the value associated with the given key.

      The result is returned as a Value, allowing callers to apply a uniform access pattern. Implementations should specify whether absence results in an exception or a particular Value state.

      Parameter:
      key - the key to look up; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a Value wrapper for the associated value; never null
      Löst aus:
      NoSuchElementException - if the key is not present in this associative array
      Seit:
      1.0.0
